# OpenF1 data

The `*_sprint_qualifying.json` files in this folder are derived from the
[OpenF1 API](https://openf1.org) (`/v1/session_result` and `/v1/drivers`) by
`app/tools/openf1_sync.py`. Each file's exact source URL is recorded in
`sprint_qualifying_meta.json` and `../MANIFEST.json`.
